# Data Projects and Case Studies

This portfolio presents practical applications of data analysis, statistics, research, and visualisation. Each case study will explain the problem, the data, the methods used, the findings, and their practical implications.

## 1. Kenya Registered Voters Analysis

**Focus:** Electoral data analysis and visualisation.

**Repository:** [View the project on GitHub](https://github.com/aranfelix2013-cloud/kenya-registered-voters-analysis)

This project provides a starting point for demonstrating how electoral registration data can support descriptive analysis and evidence-based interpretation.

The published case study will document the dataset, analytical methods, key findings, and limitations after the repository has been reviewed.

## 2. Statistical Analysis

**Focus:** Statistical testing, relationships between variables, and interpretation.

A case study will be added with a clearly defined research question, appropriate statistical methods, diagnostic checks where necessary, and an interpretation of the results.

## 3. Business Intelligence and Visualisation

**Focus:** Dashboards, reporting, and decision support.

A case study will demonstrate how data preparation and visualisation can help users monitor performance and identify meaningful patterns.

---

## How I Approach Projects

My approach begins with a clearly defined question. I examine the quality and structure of the data, select methods appropriate to the question, document the analysis, and communicate findings alongside their limitations.
